name: – After recital M – Am 3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission delegated regulation of 10 April 2026 amending Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/807 to introduce a trajectory to gradually decrease the contribution of high indirect land-use change-risk biofuels, bioliquids and biomass fuels to renewable energy targets
part_text: Ma. whereas first generation biofuels plays and will continue to play an important role in the transport sector, and this contribution should be duly recognised rather than being constrained by generic limitations introduced as an indirect way to address ILUC concerns; whereas the proposed Delegated Regulation risks contradicting the strategic objectives of developing an European biofuel value chains, as well as the protection of consumers from unnecessary increases in food and energy prices, particularly in highly exposed Member States;
